# NexRoute 0.6.3 — Discord and YouTube strategy refresh

NexRoute 0.6.3 refreshes all 21 bundled DPI strategy profiles for the failure mode observed on the affected wired network in Sibay, where Discord and YouTube targets kept responding to ping but HTTP, TLS 1.2 and TLS 1.3 failed.

## Changed

- replaced the previous uniform strategy behavior with 21 distinct refresh profiles;
- added `multisplit`, `multidisorder`, `fakedsplit`, `hostfakesplit` and `syndata` families;
- added `fooling=ts` and `fooling=badseq` variants;
- diversified split positions, sequence overlap and repeat parameters;
- strengthened QUIC handling and Discord UDP coverage;
- added dedicated critical host lists for Discord and YouTube;
- kept the refresh build-only so runtime `Apply` does not rewrite installed BAT strategy files;
- records before/after SHA-256 values for all refreshed strategies in `.service/strategy-refresh-report.json`;
- preserves the normal Service Matrix patch as the single source of runtime TCP/UDP tails;
- fails closed when any required payload file is missing.

## Critical targets

The live acceptance set is:

- `DiscordGateway`;
- `DiscordCDN`;
- `DiscordUpdates`;
- `YouTubeWeb`;
- `YouTubeShort`;
- `YouTubeImage`;
- `YouTubeVideoRedirect`.

Stable release acceptance requires one single strategy to return `HTTP:OK`, `TLS1.2:OK` and `TLS1.3:OK` for all seven targets on the affected wired network in Sibay. Results from CI, another ISP, a VPN/proxy path or a cloud runner do not replace this field test.

## Validation

The repository includes `scripts/Test-StrategyLab063Evidence.ps1` to parse the real Strategy Lab/config-test log and fail closed unless the live acceptance condition is met.

Source validation also covers:

- 21 unique strategy profiles;
- all seven critical target host lists;
- required payload presence;
- generated strategy SHA-256 provenance;
- build/runtime boundary;
- online and fully offline package builds;
- Windows launcher smoke tests;
- website typecheck and production build;
- pinned immutable Flowseal 1.10.0 upstream.

See `docs/RELEASE_0.6.3_ACCEPTANCE.md` for the exact field-test and release sequence.

## Release assets

The stable GitHub Release must contain all four verified assets together:

- `NexRoute-0.6.3-win-x64.zip`;
- `NexRoute-0.6.3-win-x64.zip.sha256`;
- `NexRoute-0.6.3-validation.json`;
- `NexRoute-0.6.3-validation.md`.

They are built by the release workflow from the pinned upstream archive and covered by GitHub artifact attestations.
